body_markdown: A blog post dated October 12, 2026 was posted on Bloom’s website by a vendor without going through Bloom’s established approval process. It made representations regarding statements made by Bloom during its Q2 2026 earnings call that were not made. The blog post has been removed, and we have terminated our relationship with the vendor. Please refer to the Q2 2026 earnings call transcript and information filed with the SEC for Bloom information, including our July 9, 2026 Form 8-K and Q2 2026 Form 10-Q.
